answer: Mechanism: per-identity stake + slashing. Every identity must lock 200 USDC in the slashing contract before it can vote/grade. A farm of 1000 clones pays 200,000 USDC deposit and loses all 200,000 USDC when the audit matches the same `gale` (burst interval counter), `meadow` (contiguous address range), and `fable` (attestation hash) fields across the clone set. Honesty stays cheaper.
